cases.first_sql:
WITH clean_products AS (
  SELECT Product_ID, Product_Name, Product_Category,
         NULLIF(regexp_replace(Product_Cost, '[^0-9.-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric AS cost,
         NULLIF(regexp_replace(Product_Price, '[^0-9.-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric AS price
  FROM toy_products
), monthly_sales AS (
  SELECT s.Product_ID, p.Product_Name,
         to_date(s.Date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sale_month,
         SUM(s.Units * p.price) AS revenue
  FROM toy_sales s
  JOIN clean_products p ON s.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
  JOIN toy_stores st ON s.Store_ID = st.Store_ID
  WHERE s.Date LIKE '2018%'
  GROUP BY s.Product_ID, p.Product_Name, sale_month
), monthly_rev AS (
  SELECT Product_ID, Product_Name, sale_month, revenue,
         LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY Product_ID ORDER BY sale_month) AS prev_rev,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Product_ID ORDER BY sale_month) AS rn
  FROM monthly_sales
)
SELECT Product_Name, sale_month
FROM monthly_rev
WHERE revenue > prev_rev
ORDER BY Product_Name, sale_month;

  FROM toy_products

WITH product_avg AS (
  SELECT "Product_ID", AVG(clean_cost) AS avg_cost
  FROM (
    SELECT "Product_ID",
           NULLIF(regexp_replace("Product_Cost", '[^0-9.-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric AS clean_cost
    FROM toy_products
  ) pc
  GROUP BY "Product_ID"
),
below_avg AS (
  SELECT tp."Product_ID"
  FROM toy_products tp
  JOIN product_avg pa ON tp."Product_ID" = pa."Product_ID"
  WHERE NULLIF(regexp_replace(tp."Product_Cost", '[^0-9.-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric < pa.avg_cost
),
sales AS (
  SELECT ts."Sale_ID", ts."Date", ts."Store_ID", ts."Product_ID", ts."Units"
  FROM toy_sales ts
  JOIN toy_stores st ON ts."Store_ID" = st."Store_ID"
  WHERE st."Store_Location" = 'Commercial'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."Sale_ID") AS sale_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(s."Units"), 0) AS total_units_sold,
       COALESCE(SUM(s."Units" * NULLIF(regexp_replace(tp."Product_Price", '[^0-9.-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric), 0) AS total_sales_revenue
FROM sales s
JOIN below_avg ba ON s."Product_ID" = ba."Product_ID"
JOIN toy_products tp ON s."Product_ID" = tp."Product_ID";

WITH sale_data AS (
  SELECT s."Store_ID", s."Product_ID", SUM(s."Units") AS total_units
  FROM toy_sales s
  JOIN toy_stores st ON s."Store_ID" = st."Store_ID"
  WHERE s."Date" >= LEFT(st."Store_Open_Date", 4) || '-01-01'
    AND s."Date" < (LEFT(st."Store_Open_Date", 4)::int + 3) || '-01-01'
  GROUP BY s."Store_ID", s."Product_ID"
),
inventory_data AS (
  SELECT i."Store_ID", i."Product_ID", SUM(i."Stock_On_Hand") AS total_stock
  FROM toy_inventory i
  GROUP BY i."Store_ID", i."Product_ID"
),
store_product_turnover AS (
  SELECT sd."Store_ID", sd."Product_ID",
         COALESCE(sd.total_units, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(id.total_stock, 0), 0) AS product_turnover
  FROM sale_data sd
  LEFT JOIN inventory_data id ON sd."Store_ID" = id."Store_ID" AND sd."Product_ID" = id."Product_ID"
),
store_turnover AS (
  SELECT "Store_ID",
         SUM(product_turnover * total_stock) / NULLIF(SUM(total_stock), 0) AS store_turnover
  FROM store_product_turnover sp
  JOIN inventory_data id ON sp."Store_ID" = id."Store_ID" AND sp."Product_ID" = id."Product_ID"
  GROUP BY "Store_ID"
)
SELECT st."Store_Name"
FROM store_turnover s
JOIN toy_stores st ON s."Store_ID" = st."Store_ID"
WHERE s.store_turnover >= (
  SELECT AVG(store_turnover) FROM store_turnover
)
ORDER BY st.Store_Name;

         p."Product_Category",
         SUM(COALESCE(s."Units",0) * (NULLIF(regexp_replace(p."Product_Price",'[^0-9.-]','','g'),'')::numeric - NULLIF(regexp_replace(p."Product_Cost",'[^0-9.-]','','g'),'')::numeric)) AS profit
